title: Port 3MF import (zip container, units, textures)
scope: 3MF package reading including unit scaling, components/build transforms and packed textures, with the original's archive and decompression limits.
acceptance: Generated and adversarial 3MF corpus (zip bombs, bad paths, missing parts, unit variants) compares original against Rust on geometry, units, refusals and limits.
The inflate/zip implementation is pure Rust and passes the P35 purity audit; the choice is a recorded decision, not an assumption.
open_items: M3 milestone batch (#114): pinned_threemf_comparison ran all 3282 cases at 602e9fa2b2d27863089e12e78d05d3370aa57ad8 with zero mismatches inside the full native oracle (75 test binaries, 0 failed); artifact inventory evidence/2026-11-05-m3-batch-native-artifact-inventory.json.gz. Verification level unchanged (none); no acceptance claim.

Earlier report evidence (plan/findings/2026-11-03-threemf-review-regressions.md, tested at 31ebafcce734cecd265e756823caf285a15412a4): #58 follow-up: pre-allocation aggregate ZIP budget and UTF-16 directory basename fallback; retained six seeds and all earlier cases, 24,564 packages, zero divergences; red runs and complete-corpus wrong-value canary retained. No acceptance claim.
Not in ci/native-suites.json: no registered case inventory; runs locally as an ignored test (see the finding for the command). Not wired to cargo xtask fuzz (rust/xtask is held by other open PRs).
Host-limit class: an archive entry whose declared size exceeds the caller's cap is refused where the original reads it (io.inflate allocates the declared size); owner decision with H1 to H3.
Packed texture images are read by a second unzip in src/app/scanFiles.ts and belong to io.obj.companions.images (own PNG, then JPEG decoder).
Only Node 22 ran the original; no Chrome execution. No real package from Bambu, Orca, PrusaSlic3r or 3D Builder was available locally.
Zip and inflate are our own code, decided in plan/decisions/2026-11-03-own-inflate-zip-png-jpeg.md and delivered by io.inflate.

Historical first-run report retained at plan/findings/2026-11-03-threemf-first-run.md; its 107-file private corpus was not rerun on this follow-up. Current six-seed generated results and raw identities are in #97.
